name: What is the difference between suction grab bars and professionally mounted grab bars?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between suction grab bars and professionally mounted grab bars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard shower grab bars must support at least 250 pounds of downward pull, while suction-cup handles are not safe for bearing body weight. Suction bars rely on temporary air seals that easily fail on textured tile, grout seams, or damp surfaces, creating a severe fall hazard. Structurally fastened grab bars anchor directly into wood wall studs, internal blocking, or rated solid-wall fasteners. While permanent installation requires drilling into drywall or tile, it provides the continuous mechanical strength needed for true safety and accessibility modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionally mounted bars anchor directly into wall framing to support 250+ pounds. Suction bars easily lose their seal on tile and are not safe for body support.
